D: A broke Depression-era boxer makes an unlikely comeback to keep his family together.
P: Serve the mains when the Braddocks sit down to their thin family dinner.
S: Toasted baguette with whipped lemon ricotta and salami

Toasted baguette spread with whipped lemon ricotta, topped with folded salami, a sliver of pickled onion and cracked pepper. Bought and paid for this time. Slice a baguette into 16 thin rounds, brush with olive oil and toast at 200C for 6 minutes until golden. Whip 200g ricotta with the zest of a lemon, a pinch of salt and a drizzle of olive oil until smooth. Spread on the toasts and top each with a folded slice of salami from 150g. Finish with a sliver of pickled onion, cracked black pepper and a few parsley leaves.
Thick white bread fried golden in beef dripping with salt and pepper
Thick slices of white bread fried slowly in hot beef dripping until golden and crisp on both sides, drained, sprinkled with flaky salt and cracked pepper, served hot.
the fight crowd at the big arena

Franks simmered then griddled until blistered, in steamed buns with yellow mustard and sauerkraut warmed with caraway and onion, wrapped in wax paper. Fry a sliced onion in 20g butter until soft, add 400g drained sauerkraut and 1 tsp caraway seeds and warm through for 10 minutes. Simmer 8 franks in water for 5 minutes, then griddle until blistered. Steam 8 hot dog buns over the simmering water for 1 minute. Fill each bun with a frank, a line of yellow mustard and a spoon of the kraut. Wrap each in wax paper to serve.
M: Beef shin, carrots, potatoes and pearl barley simmered 3 hours
Beef shin browned, onion, carrot, potato and barley, stock and thyme, simmered 3 hours until thick. Bread.
Comeback rib eye with mash and gravy
the first proper meal after a win

Rib eye seared hard and basted in butter and thyme, rested, with buttery mashed potato, minted peas and a rich gravy made from the pan juices. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 80g butter and 100ml hot milk. Season 4 rib eye steaks and sear in a smoking pan for 3 minutes, then flip, add 40g butter and thyme and baste for 3 minutes. Rest 5 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the pan, whisk in 300ml beef stock and simmer until thick. Cook 300g frozen peas with butter and chopped mint. Serve together.
W: Day-old bread baked in cinnamon custard with sultanas
Day-old bread torn into a buttered dish with sultanas, soaked 20 minutes in a custard of eggs, milk, brown sugar and cinnamon, baked at 170C for 40 minutes until puffed and golden.
K: Milk warmed with honey, cinnamon and vanilla, whisked frothy

Full cream milk warmed slowly with honey, a cinnamon stick and vanilla, frothed and poured into mugs with fresh nutmeg grated over the top. Pour 1L full cream milk into a saucepan with 3 tbsp honey, a cinnamon stick and half a tsp vanilla extract. Warm gently over low heat for 8 minutes, stirring, until steaming but not boiling. Remove the cinnamon stick. Whisk hard for 30 seconds until frothy, or use a milk frother. Pour into four mugs and grate fresh nutmeg over each.

m.note: Beef shin, carrots, potatoes and pearl barley simmered 3 hours
m.how: Brown 800g diced beef shin. Add 2 onions, 3 carrots, 400g potatoes, 100g pearl barley and 1.2L stock with thyme. Simmer 3 hours until thick. Serve with bread to make it go further.

w.note: Day-old bread baked in cinnamon custard with sultanas
w.how: Tear 8 slices day-old bread into a buttered dish and scatter with 80g sultanas. Whisk 3 eggs, 500ml milk, 60g brown sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon and pour over. Soak 20 minutes and bake at 170C for 40 minutes.
